page_title: ESP 1-0 RAY | Espanyol v Rayo Vallecano 07/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Marko Dmitrovic as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
90+6' The game is interrupted. Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
90+4' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jose Sanchez saw the whole situation.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
89' The manager makes a subsitution with Ruben Sanchez (Espanyol) coming on for Pere Milla.
89' The attendance for today's match is 28110.
87' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) seems to have forgotten that he has already received a yellow card as he is surprised when the referee shows him a second one!
87' Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) is awarded a yellow card.
86' Here's the change. Nobel Mendy leaves the pitch and Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) comes on as a substitute.
84' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Espanyol players look gutted.
83' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Espanyol players aren’t happy.
82' Goal! Kike Garcia (Espanyol) receives the ball on the edge of the box and lobs the goalkeeper, who was off his line. He makes it 2:0.
80' Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
80' Manolo Gonzalez prepares a substitution. Exposito is replaced by Ramon Terrats (Espanyol).
80' Substitution. Roberto Fernandez Jaen is replaced by Kike Garcia (Espanyol).
77' The referee is firm and issues Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) a deserved yellow card.
76' Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) has tested the patience of referee Jose Sanchez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
75' So close! Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
75' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) hits a shot towards the bottom right corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Augusto Batalla.
73' Jose Sanchez shows a yellow card to Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) for his blatant foul.
73' Espanyol earn a corner.
70' Here is a change. Jorge de Frutos is going off and Inigo Perez gives the last tactical orders to Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano).
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) will replace Fran Perez.
69' The Espanyol players can’t believe it after referee Jose Sanchez signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
65' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Espanyol! Let's see what he decides.
65' Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
64' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) does not realise that he has already received a yellow card and is shocked when the referee shows him a second one!
63' Jose Sanchez shows a yellow card to Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) for his blatant foul.
60' Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header well wide of the left post. What a poor effort.
59' Espanyol force their opponents to concede a corner.
58' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) commits a rough challenge and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul. Espanyol win a free kick.
56' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to substitute Pol Lozano and he is replaced by Charles Pickel (Espanyol).
55' Rayo Vallecano string together a series of short passes.
53' The ball is out of play. Rayo Vallecano win a corner kick.
52' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Gerard Gumbau.
50' Tempers flare after Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) commits a foul. He receives a yellow card for his bad challenge and surely must be relieved at not receiving a red card.
48' Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save.
48' Espanyol will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
47' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
42' Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) has tested the patience of referee Jose Sanchez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
39' 1 - 0 Goal! Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Augusto Batalla into the bottom left corner.
39' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) is going to take the penalty!
39' Jose Sanchez has a clear sight and sees a foul from Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano). The referee uncompromisingly points to the spot and it's a penalty to Espanyol.
36' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
31' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pol Lozano (Espanyol) was quite harsh and Jose Sanchez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
29' Rayo Vallecano hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.

27' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) blows a huge opportunity after receiving a cross from the free kick. He shoots from just outside of the box, but the ball goes narrowly over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
26' Rayo Vallecano have a free kick from a promising distance.
25' The game is interrupted. Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
21' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
19' The ball is out of play. Espanyol will have a throw-in.
16' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Sanchez had an easy-decision to make.
14' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
12' Rayo Vallecano keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
10' Espanyol have been awarded a corner kick.
9' The ball goes out for a corner. Espanyol can continue in their attacking effort.
6' Pere Milla (Espanyol) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
3' The resulting set piece from Espanyol is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
3' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. The linesman makes the right call and Espanyol will have a corner.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Espanyol will have the kick-off.
Jose Sanchez got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
